name: hermes-helmet
description: First-officer skills for Hermes Helmet: setup, single-issue delivery, and dependent-issue coordination.

interface.shortDescription: First-officer skills for delegated GitHub delivery with Hermes Helmet.
interface.longDescription: Packages the Captain-side setup-helmet, helmet-issue, and helmet-epic skills from this repository. You remain Captain. Claude Code or Codex runs on the Captain host with the Captain GitHub identity. The published Docker image still runs Hermes under a separate worker identity. Installing the plugin copies instructions only; helmet, gh, model login, authority policy, and worker access still come from the existing setup.
defaultPrompt: Set up Hermes Helmet first-officer skills on this Captain host.
Coordinate a single GitHub issue through helmet-issue.
Coordinate dependent GitHub issues with helmet-epic.
